list.description: What the list is: fixtures, articles, players

count.description: How many items the design draws, a positive number. "data" is the value for whatever the data holds (a person chose it, or the design draws no fixed number): never send 0

groupBy.description: What one card gathers several items by, when it does: date (one card per day, its matches inside). Left out when each card is one item

field.description: What the design shows, in plain words: team name, team crest, score, kickoff time

example.description: The design's placeholder for it, as drawn: "166/5", "WOMEN", "21 JULY"

kind.description: What kind of value the design draws there, when known (bind.load's draftNeed has it): the output is checked to hold that kind

alternatives.description: What the design's cards say at this place when they differ by kind of item (a bowler's card, a batter's): the output gives every one, and each item the ones its kind has

required.description: true when the design is wrong without it (teams, scores); false for what it can do without (a tickets link, a crest)

must.description: What the data has to be about, from the design: the team, the competition. Data about another one does not give the need

hints.description: The design's own words that name the data: a heading, a label, a designer's note

hook.description: A hook a person already chose for this section: start from it

order.description: Which items and in what order, from the design's words: soonest-first (a list of what is coming: AHEAD, NEXT, UPCOMING), newest-first (results, news, recent), upcoming-then-latest (a strip that shows what is next and then what just happened), as-is when nothing says. Sort, filter and cut to the count after sorting

filterBy.description: A page choice (tabs, a toggle, a filter) that decides which items of the list show. The output is ONE list whose items carry a field holding the option each belongs to, written as the options are

key.description: The page choice that filters the list: its key

options.description: The choice's option values, as the page writes and compares them (`_page.<key>`): the items' field holds exactly these

sources.description: Feeds a person gave for this data: build on them first, before looking for a hook or a connector that already exists

label.description: Which part of the design it is for, as the person said it: women, men, fixtures

url.description: The feed's full URL, query included, as the person gave it

need.description: What the design shows as data
